messages:
nina: hey — post-canary checks for notifications-chart v1.7.0 failed in us-east small pool. deploy-bot reported multiple pods stuck Pending with PVC attach timeout after the chart bumped nodeAffinity values.

deploy-bot: promotion blocked — 3/6 pods Pending (0/3 PVCs attached) namespace notifications-canary. error: AttachVolume.Attach failed for volume "pvc-abc123": timeout waiting for volume attach.

tom: I saw the values change: `affinity.nodeSelectorTerms[0].matchExpressions` got stricter in v1.7.0 (region: us-east -> required). that could push pods to a subset of nodes without available volume topology.

harpreet: yes — the backend storage topology is zone-scoped. tighter affinity sent pods to zone-a where we have no free PVs. options: 1) rollback to v1.6.9, 2) relax affinity in-cluster and retry, 3) manually expand PVs (not ideal during a promo).

nina: we should rollback and pin the chart until we verify affinity rules and update storageclass topology. fastest route to unblock. anyone object?

sre-oncall: +1 for rollback. if you rollback, annotate the namespace so deploy-bot doesn't auto-promote while we triage. use `release-management/hold` and `release-management/pinned-chart`. I'll keep an eye on attach errors during rollback.

tom: prepared commands:
```
# prevent auto-promote and pin chart
kubectl annotate namespace notifications-canary release-management/hold=true --overwrite
kubectl annotate namespace notifications-canary release-management/pinned-chart=v1.6.9 --overwrite
# rollback
helm rollback notifications-release 4 --namespace notifications-canary
```

harpreet: I'll open a PR to make affinity opt-in behind `values.affinity.strict: false` default, and add a preflight that checks volume topology availability before promoting. assigning to @harpreet ETA 4h.

deploy-bot: manual action recorded: rollback requested by @nina for release notifications-release -> target chart v1.6.9. Promotion hold applied.

nina: rolling back now, will update changelog: "Reverted notifications-chart to v1.6.9 due to PV topology/affinity mismatch in v1.7.0; hold applied until affinity/storageclass verified."

deploy-bot: helm rollback successful. release notifications-release -> v1.6.9. Promotion hold remains until annotation removed.

sre-oncall: monitoring cluster events — no new attach timeouts post-rollback. once PR merges and we run a small targeted canary with adjusted affinity + topology checks, we'll remove the hold and re-promote outside the primary change window.

nina: thanks team. I'll post a short note in #changelog and tag infra for storageclass review.
